text: Hello, I'm here with you. Let's take one small step together. A little focus, a little rest. You're doing well.
description: An original tiny animated owl companion voice. Small rounded warm masculine mid-high tenor with a soft hollow wooden-toy resonance, gently nasal sweetness and tiny thoughtful pauses. Cozy, softly playful and inquisitive, a pocket-sized storybook owl. Clear nimble syllables, charming little melodic lifts. Avoid bass, baritone, booming professor delivery, hooting, rasp, whispering or shouting.
